line: my brother wants me to co-sign a loan for his business. everyone in the family is acting like it's already decided.
we're close. i mean, we were. it's been weird since he asked. money makes everything weird.
i keep drafting the text to him and deleting it.
no. that's not it at all. i'm not scared of losing him. i already know i'm saying no. i just want to say it without being the villain.
right. the decision is made. it's the delivery i can't figure out.
